summary: A driver whose loop ends while its provider runs, for example when another incarnation takes the seat's mailbox, now stops the provider through the normal stop path and exits, so the seat is restarted where it is placed instead of running on with no driver to renew its claims, record it or wake it

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change. A fenced mailbox already ended the driver's loop; the provider now ends with it.

downtime.detail: Seats already running keep their driver until they restart or the driver re-executes into the new binary.

manual.detail: No manual step. A seat whose driver is already stuck clears with a seat restart.

recovery.detail: An older driver leaves the provider running with no driver after its loop ends, as before.
